findings.statement: No K6 domain or numerical false-green was reproduced. The attempt-3 implementation explicitly evaluates all 18 +/- coordinate-gradient atoms, obtains zero mean and covariance I9/9, numerically reproduces curl energy 2/3, divergence energy 1/3, and RMS ratio sqrt(2) for both D2 and D4, and rejects the lock for the correlated all-ones-gradient challenge (ratio 0). The D2/D4 periodic and one-sided boundary formulas, manufactured analytic curl/divergence, four periodic grids, four closed-boundary grids, interior/collar decomposition, midpoint interpolation order, amplitude-gradient product closure, continuum fits, and numerical D2-as-D4 mutant all replay consistently with the frozen contract. Current literal module/symbol/card-path searches find no empirical consumer; only registered PR-123 generator/test/artifact surfaces consume the mechanics card. The generated card is byte-current and the focused suite passes 12/12.
assumptions_used: The registered claim is C2 numerical mechanics only, not empirical vorticity inference or production remediation.
The sqrt(2) identity depends only on the registered zero mean and second-moment tensor E[G_ij G_kl]=(1/9) delta_ik delta_jl; full joint Gaussianity is not required for this quadratic energy ratio.
Cartesian curl uses curl(v)_i=epsilon_ijk partial_j v_k and divergence uses partial_i v_i.
The checked-in four-grid sets and thresholds in pr123_spec.yaml are frozen inputs to this replay.
PR-123 tests and generated mechanics artifacts are allowed consumers and are not empirical consumers.
reproduction: Run the isolated artifact --check command recorded above and require return code 0 with status=current.
Run the two focused pytest files recorded above and require 12 passed.
Search htt, scripts, tests, and docs for the module path, all exported K6 symbols, PR123-K6-CONTINUUM, and pr123_k6_continuum_card; classify every hit against the registered allowed-consumer list.
unresolved: The built-in runtime consumer inventory is literal-text heuristic rather than an AST/dataflow proof and would not by itself detect an arbitrary future reader of the generated card path. Independent current-tree literal card-path and symbol scans found no violating consumer, so this is a follow-up hardening risk, not a reproduced current gate failure.
No broad repository suite was run because this assignment is a targeted read-only K6 replay; the byte-current builder check plus the two focused files cover the registered K6 gate.

findings.title: Callable aliases and dynamic builtin indirection bypass the lineage scanner
assumptions: The spec's fail_closed_on production_import_or_resolvable_call requirement covers semantically resolvable aliases and dynamic builtin access, not only direct ast.Call names.
A negative scanner probe may use a temporary file outside the worktree without changing repository state.

reproduction.environment: Python 3.12.3, repository venv, git HEAD e77510170424eecd49112ed6c33424ce455b154c
reproduction.command_summary: Import the PR-123 builder and call _automated_scan_checks(path, {'mv_weights'}) on three temporary snippets: g=getattr followed by g(obj,'mv_weights')(x); alias=mv_weights followed by alias(x); and __builtins__['getattr'](obj,'mv_weights')(x).
reproduction.expected: At least one scanner check must be false for every snippet.

findings.source: _automated_scan_checks records only direct ast.Name/ast.Attribute callees. It does not propagate assignments that alias forbidden symbols or dynamic builtins, and it does not recognize subscripted builtins access.
findings.consequence: A reference can call a mapped production implementation while receiving an all-green automated_scan_checks record. The generated all_rows_valid=true and PASS_MECHANICS_C2 lineage status therefore overstate the enforced independence guarantee.
findings.required_fix: Add fail-closed alias/dataflow handling or conservatively reject callable aliasing and dynamic builtin access in reference closures. Add negative tests for direct aliases, getattr aliases, imported dynamic-call aliases, and __builtins__ subscript access; then regenerate and replay all PR-123 artifacts.

findings.statement: The summary fields clean_passed, mutant_killed, and status are not recalculated from primitive property outcomes, counts, and failed-property records. An internally inconsistent summary can therefore remain unchallenged by this consistency layer.
assumptions: Primitive property records, counts, and failed-property records are the authoritative inputs for these derived summary fields.

reproducibility.method: Previously established replay finding recovered without a new execution.

findings.statement: Seed-schedule fields are compared by equality but are not required to have exact integer types. Numerically equal non-integer-typed values can therefore satisfy the comparison.
assumptions: The seed schedule contract requires integer-typed seed fields, not only values that compare equal to integers.
